purpose: Teach: 蠅/襪/繩/簑/襦/其/其の/舛

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、窓に蠅、つまり虫が入って気にされてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was worried about a fly that got in through the window.
lines.style: Soft, remembering tone. Speaking as if sharing a small, private observation. Pace unhurried. Gentle affection in the naming.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、足袋、つまり襪を集めるご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer collects tabi—socks, actually. It's a hobby of theirs.
lines.style: Warm recollection. Slight correction with gentleness, not condescension. Even pacing. The tone of someone noticing the details others miss.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、藁繩、つまり縄の編み方を教えて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer taught me how to braid straw rope. Took the time to show me.
lines.style: Quiet admiration. Lingering slightly on the memory. Slower pace on the teaching part. A note of gratitude underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、博物館の簑、つまり昔の蓑のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer told me all about museum raincoats—old-style mino, the history of them.
lines.style: Engaged, listening tone. As if recounting something that held their attention. Measured pace. Slight lift of interest in the detail.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、和装の襦袢、つまり襦のお手入れ法を尋ねて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer asked me how to care for a juban—proper undergarment maintenance.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact gentleness. Speaking of a small, particular kindness. Even tone. The ease of someone who didn't find the question odd.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「其の席に座って下さい」って古風な物言いで仰ったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer said 'Please, take that seat' in the most old-fashioned way.
lines.style: Light wonder in the voice. Slight smile underneath. Slow, appreciative pace on the quoted phrase. The tone of noticing something charming.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「其、まさに私の好み」って自信ありげに仰ったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer said 'Yes, that's exactly my taste' with such quiet confidence.
lines.style: Dry underneath, but warm. Slight irony in the confidence noted. Brisk, knowing pace. The affectionate observation of someone who recognizes themselves.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご注文の品が舛違いだったって謙虚に仰ったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, when the order came wrong, that customer mentioned it so humbly. Apologized for the inconvenience.
lines.style: Gentle, almost protective tone. Slow on the humility. Trailing off with quiet sadness at the graciousness. The voice of someone moved by kindness.
